snippet.title: Magically Sorted - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Magically Sorted on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4622320/?utm_source=youtube

Tidy up an alchemy shop full of magical curiosities and brew powerful potions!

It's a first-person organizational/tidy up game set in an alchemy shop. 

✨Sort through 3338 scattered items: potions with curious effects, ingredients, and old alchemy books. Then find each one its rightful place on the shelves.

✨Step up to the cauldron and put the ingredients to work. Brew powerful potions to gain helpful abilities that make tidying up easier.

✨All items in the shop have something worth discovering: curious effects, peculiar properties, or a bit of magical lore, written in the descriptions or hidden in the item itself.

Game by Secret Burrow.

Composer: Blue Lava Music

#tidyup #sortinggame #sortinggames #indiegame #cozygaming #cozygames
